_comment: Wallets the chain tape watches, curated by hand -- no FOMO session required.
Addresses come from public profiles and from the public chain itself:
scripts/chain_tape_bench.py shows which wallets are actually trading a
watched pair, and anything with real swap activity is a candidate here.
fomo_user_id is optional -- omit it and a stable 'manual:<address>' id is
derived, so a wallet known only by address still gets a registry row.
Fill in handle/display_name when you know who a wallet belongs to.

wallets.note: PONS/USDG: heavy seller, 13 swaps in a 400-block sample
PONS/USDG: accumulator, 10 buys and no sells in the same window
